## Description

Models mutually exciting point processes for buy/sell order arrivals, cancellations, and execution bursts to forecast ultra-short-term order book dynamics.

## Where it may fit

Microsecond order book imbalances, flash crashes, high-frequency liquidity provision, and trade toxicity detection.

## Vehicles

High-frequency market makers, proprietary prop trading desks, algorithmic execution desks.

## Required data

Level 2 / Level 3 Limit Order Book (LOB) tick data with nanosecond/millisecond event timestamps.

## Caveats

Requires C++/Rust low-latency implementation for real-time execution; parameter estimation requires maximum likelihood on high-density event streams.
